 Job Description 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Associate Consultant with up to 1 year of experience in Python development, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and AI programming . The candidate will work with senior architects and developers to build cloud-native applications, AI-powered solutions, integrations, and automation tools on SAP BTP.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain applications using Python .
 Build and deploy applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) .
 Assist in developing AI and Generative AI solutions using frameworks such as OpenAI, LangChain, and SAP AI Core.
 Create REST APIs and integrate SAP and non-SAP systems.
 Support development of chatbots, AI agents, and automation solutions.
 Work with databases such as SAP HANA Cloud, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
 Participate in unit testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
 Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and project teams.
 Prepare technical documentation and user guides.
 Follow Agile development methodologies and DevOps practices.
 Required Skills 
 0-1 year experience in software development.
 Strong knowledge of Python programming.
 Basic understanding of SAP BTP services : SAP CAP
 SAP HANA Cloud
 SAP Integration Suite
 SAP Build Apps
 SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub (preferred)
 
 Understanding of REST APIs and JSON.
 Knowledge of Git, GitHub, or Azure DevOps.
 
 Qualifications 
Bachelors - Computer Engineering, Bachelors - Computer Science, Bachelors - Information Technology, Masters - Software Engineering 
 Certifications 
MuleSoft Certified Developer - Level 1 - Trailhead, Salesforce Certified Javascript Developer 1 - Salesforce, ServiceNow Certified Application Developer - ServiceNow 
 Required Skills 
AI Programming, Python (Programming Language), SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), SAP Overview

English (Required)
